capabilities.ui: business web app and reviewer renderer

limitations: A request is processed only when Infra applies passage.request.processed with a matching business-day computation; the App never schedules itself.
One I-20 per account and one request in processing at a time; travel signatures only (no OPT, address or other e-forms).
Notices for Mail are written into state as CloudEvents; Infra publishes them through Messaging.
Text only: no PDF or scanned I-20.
